categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: semiconductor packaging and testing services, and electronic manufacturing services (EMS). The semiconductor segment focuses on IC packaging and testing for various semiconductor components, while the EMS segment provides PCB assembly, box build, system integration, and rapid prototyping services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced semiconductor packaging processes such as 3D NAND flash packaging, flip chip, CSP BGA, and high thermal dissipation materials. The company integrates semiconductor packaging with SMT technology and employs automated production lines, smart manufacturing, and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global semiconductor manufacturers, especially in the NAND flash memory market, and EMS clients in sectors such as servers, aerospace, oil exploration, automotive electronics, IoT, AI, and 5G communications. Major end markets include consumer electronics, mobile devices, automotive electronics, and industrial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with headquarters and multiple factories in Kaohsiung. Its sales are distributed globally, with significant exports to the United States and Asia. It also extends services internationally, including satellite and aerospace sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream contract manufacturer and service provider in the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on IC packaging and testing as well as downstream electronic manufacturing services. It collaborates closely with upstream wafer and chip suppliers and downstream OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening presence in the memory market (especially LPDDR and DDR), developing high-end packaging technologies, expanding into IoT and automotive electronics, and advancing third-generation semiconductor processes. The company emphasizes sustainability, low-carbon materials, smart production management, and continuous product innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through contract manufacturing and service fees for semiconductor packaging and testing, and electronic manufacturing services. The company does not sell branded products but earns from providing manufacturing, assembly, testing, and related services to clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the global semiconductor packaging and EMS markets, holding a niche position with a focus on memory packaging and high-quality EMS for specialized applications like aerospace and oil exploration. It leverages integrated capabilities and strategic partnerships to maintain competitiveness against larger global players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported annual revenues around NT$16.3 billion with a slight decline from the previous year due to market softness. Net profit decreased by approximately 35%. It maintains a stable asset base with ongoing capital expenditures to expand capacity and automation. R&D spending accounts for about 2.5% of revenue, supporting steady innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, diversified cost structures, rapid delivery, and global logistics support. Its integrated semiconductor packaging and EMS capabilities provide customers with optimized resource utilization and enhanced core competitiveness. Sustainability and compliance with environmental and social governance standards further differentiate its offerings.
